name: store-screenshot-studio
description: Turn raw app screenshots into App Store and Google Play listing images: headline and subheadline, iPhone / Android / iPad device frames, solid or gradient backgrounds, several languages, and exact store pixel sizes (iPhone 6.9″/6.5″/5.5″, iPad 13″, Play phone/tablet) exported as opaque PNGs. Checks long headlines, missing translations and blurry screenshots. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn raw app screenshots into App Store and Google Play listing images: headline and subheadline, iPhone / Android / iPad device frames, solid or gradient backgrounds, several languages, and exact store pixel sizes (iPhone 6.9″/6.5″/5.5″, iPad 13″, Play phone/tablet) exported as opaque PNGs. Checks long headlines, missing translations and blurry screenshots. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 App 原始截图做成 App Store 和 Google Play 的宣传截图：加主副标题、iPhone / 安卓 / iPad 设备边框、纯色或渐变背景，支持多语言，按商店要求的精确像素尺寸（iPhone 6.9″/6.5″/5.5″、iPad 13″、Google Play 手机/平板）导出无透明通道的 PNG。自动检查标题过长、缺少翻译和截图分辨率不足。全部本地处理，无需 API 密钥。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。标题文字使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）完整路径。默认自动查找系统中文字体（macOS: 苹方 / 冬青黑体，Windows: 微软雅黑，Linux: Noto Sans CJK）。
